name: Ward Restocking

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you know Hammerfall needs steady shipments of tonics and medicine. They help keep its soldiers, defenders, and travelers standing against threats in the Arathi Highlands.
As an Undead, you know Apothecary Jorell carries the Royal Apothecary Society’s presence into Arathi. His erratic behavior and toxic experiments at Go'Shek Farm frustrate even his allies.

faq.answer: Doctor Gregory Victor oversees Hammerfall’s medical ward and infirmary. When regular deliveries fail, he asks dependable travelers to retrieve supplies.
faq.q: Who offers the quest Ward Restocking?

faq.answer: Apothecary Jorell works from a small shack at Go'Shek Farm, south and slightly west of Hammerfall along the road in the Arathi Highlands.
Doctor Gregory Victor sends you to Go'Shek Farm because Apothecary Jorell failed to deliver an urgently needed crate of antidotes and elixirs to the Hammerfall infirmary.
faq.q: Why does Doctor Gregory Victor send you to Go'Shek Farm?

aliases: what items do you pick up
faq.answer: The ward needs a case of Packaged Tonics containing Apothecary Jorell’s antidotes and elixirs. They will replenish the Hammerfall medical ward’s dwindling stocks.
faq.q: What supplies are needed for the ward?

faq.answer: Doctor Gregory Victor suspects Jorell either poisoned himself again while brewing concoctions in his poorly ventilated shack or neglected his duties to the ward.
faq.q: Why hasn't Apothecary Jorell delivered the supplies himself?

aliases: who to turn in ward restocking
faq.answer: Bring the case of tonics from Go'Shek Farm to Doctor Gregory Victor at the medical ward in Hammerfall.
faq.q: Where must the supplies be delivered?

sections.body: Doctor Gregory Victor tends Hammerfall’s wounded and ailing in the medical ward. The nearby Forsaken apothecary usually supplies the infirmary with remedies, antidotes, and elixirs. When those deliveries stop, Victor turns to capable travelers to keep the clinic stocked.
sections.title: A Shortage in the Ward

sections.body: Apothecary Jorell works in a cramped shack at Go'Shek Farm, south and west of Hammerfall. Doctor Victor says Jorell is often absent. The eccentric Forsaken chemist may neglect his duties or succumb to his own noxious concoctions. Couriers sent for the packaged tonics should find the medicine waiting, whether Jorell is there or not.
sections.title: The Recluse of Go'Shek Farm

summary: At Hammerfall, Doctor Gregory Victor is short of remedies, antidotes, and elixirs for the infirmary. The missing tonics are at Go'Shek Farm.
